sceneBriefs: Sami wakes in his bed and sits up.

Sami walks toward school carrying his schoolbag and wearing the same blue shirt.

sceneBriefs: Layla plants a small jasmine plant with white blossoms in soil beside the house.
Sami walks toward the same house carrying a small watering can full of water.
Sami waters the newly planted jasmine as Layla watches.
Sami and Layla sit on two chairs beside the house and look at their jasmine plant.
